# The Mythical Man-Month

By Brooks.

The writing is clear and the examples are memorable. Key takeaway: decide what not to do before deciding what to do. A good book for a long flight.

It changed how I run the weekly review. The middle part drags, the last third makes up for it. The audiobook narrator is excellent.

The author uses many case studies, some feel cherry-picked.
